assumptions.statement: Lithium-ion cell chemistry with nominal voltage 3.7V, operating range 2.5V-4.2V
assumptions.rationale: Based on foxBMS supported chemistries; defines voltage limits for SOA
assumptions.validity_conditions: Applies to Li-ion, LiFePO4, NMC chemistries. Not applicable to LTO (different voltage range).
assumptions.invalidation_consequence: Voltage limits must be reconfigured per chemistry; SOA thresholds invalid

assumptions.statement: Thermal runaway initiates at cell voltage > 4.3V and temperature > 60°C
assumptions.rationale: Conservative boundary from literature; defines hazardous event boundary
assumptions.validity_conditions: Valid for NMC/LCO chemistries. LFP has higher thermal stability.
assumptions.invalidation_consequence: ASIL assignment may change; FTTI budget may need adjustment

assumptions.statement: Vehicle charger respects BMS charge current limits communicated via CAN
assumptions.validity_conditions: Requires compatible charger. Non-compliant charger is external hazard.
assumptions.invalidation_consequence: Overcharge protection relies solely on contactor opening

assumptions.statement: AFE SPI communication latency < 5 ms (including DMA transfer and PEC validation)
assumptions.rationale: Based on LTC6811/6813 datasheet timing at 1 MHz SPI with DMA
assumptions.validity_conditions: Assumes 1 MHz SPI, DMA available, no bus contention. Validated on target.
assumptions.invalidation_consequence: FTTI budget exceeded; acquisition period must increase

assumptions.statement: Cell voltage measurement noise follows Gaussian distribution with sigma <= 5 mV
assumptions.rationale: Based on AFE datasheet accuracy (±1.5 mV) plus system noise margin
assumptions.validity_conditions: Valid for calibrated AFE at 25°C. Noise increases at temperature extremes.
assumptions.invalidation_consequence: Debounce count may be insufficient; false positive rate increases

assumptions.statement: Contactor mechanical opening time <= 30 ms (worst case) at -40°C to +85°C
assumptions.rationale: Based on typical automotive contactor datasheets (e.g., TE Connectivity EV200)
assumptions.validity_conditions: Valid for specified contactor model. Degraded contactors may exceed.
assumptions.invalidation_consequence: FTTI budget exceeded; independent monitor required

assumptions.statement: SBC (FS85xx) watchdog is independent of main MCU and can trigger contactor opening
assumptions.rationale: FS85xx datasheet specifies independent watchdog with fail-safe outputs
assumptions.validity_conditions: Requires correct SBC configuration. Shared power supply is common cause.
assumptions.invalidation_consequence: Single point of failure for contactor control; ASIL D not achievable

assumptions.statement: Independent hardware voltage monitor (ASIL B) can be implemented with separate voltage dividers, comparator, and contactor drive
assumptions.rationale: Addresses timing budget violation (115 ms > 100 ms FTTI) in main path
assumptions.validity_conditions: Requires PCB space, separate power domain, additional BOM cost. Feasibility to be confirmed.
assumptions.invalidation_consequence: Must rely on main path timing optimization or accept residual risk

assumptions.statement: Current sensor (Isabellenhutte IVT-S / LEM CAB500 / Honeywell BAS6C) provides +/-0.5% accuracy over -40°C to +85°C
assumptions.rationale: Datasheet specifications for automotive current sensors
assumptions.validity_conditions: Requires periodic calibration. Accuracy degrades with temperature cycling.
assumptions.invalidation_consequence: SOA current limits may be inaccurate; power estimation affected

assumptions.statement: NTC temperature sensors (EPCOS B57332) with polynomial interpolation provide +/-1°C accuracy over -40°C to +125°C
assumptions.rationale: Based on sensor datasheet and foxBMS polynomial implementation
assumptions.validity_conditions: Requires calibration at 3 points. Self-heating effect neglected.
assumptions.invalidation_consequence: SOA temperature limits may be inaccurate; thermal protection degraded

assumptions.statement: FreeRTOS task scheduling provides deterministic execution with worst-case latency < 2 ms for high-priority safety tasks
assumptions.rationale: FreeRTOS config with configUSE_PREEMPTION=1, priority-based scheduling
assumptions.validity_conditions: Assumes no priority inversion, stack overflow, or interrupt latency spikes.
assumptions.invalidation_consequence: Software timing budget violated; SOA check may miss deadline

assumptions.statement: FRAM (MB85RS64) retains data across power cycles with 10^12 write cycles endurance
assumptions.rationale: Fujitsu FRAM datasheet; used for fault logging and contactor cycle count
assumptions.validity_conditions: Write endurance sufficient for 15-year vehicle life at 100 cycles/day
assumptions.invalidation_consequence: Fault history and cycle count lost; warranty/maintenance impact
